title: Ladybug in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q68 66 70 78 Q66 80 62 78 Q58 70 52 66 Z' fill='#ff7b54' stroke='#ffb27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d='M28 56 Q50 64 72 56 Q72 64 50 70 Q28 64 28 56 Z' fill='#ff5e3a' stroke='#ffb27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- scarf knot/end left -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q22 62 20 72 Q24 74 28 72 Q30 64 34 62 Z' fill='#ff7b54' stroke='#ffb27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M32 70 Q24 76 20 82' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 70 Q76 76 80 82' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 74 Q34 82 34 88' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 74 Q66 82 66 88' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body base (dark red shell) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#d62839'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- center line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#3a0510' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='5' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='5' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#7a1020' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='14' fill='#1a0206' stroke='#5a0a18' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='4' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='4' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='2' fill='#1a0206'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='2' fill='#1a0206'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='25' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='25' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 33 Q50 37 55 33' stroke='#ffe9b0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M42 16 Q36 6 30 4' stroke='#1a0206' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 16 Q64 6 70 4' stroke='#1a0206' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='4' r='2.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='4' r='2.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
</svg>
